verdict.rationale: Skills are installed, tested and invoked through Anthropic's official terminal tool, Claude Code. Its official marketplace commands (`/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`) install skills, the `--plugin-dir` flag tests them locally, `/skill-name` invokes them, and `claude -p` supports scripted, piped runs. That CLI is a host agent, not a dedicated Skills CLI, and skill management happens through in-session slash commands. Missing for 10: a standalone first-party Skills CLI for creating, validating, uploading or versioning skills (that is done via the Skills API instead), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI-driven skill workflows.
